rule: R8 Late sniper: at 5 minutes before the start buy every listed bet with EV >= 2.5% (builder label: NO GAIN, thin)
numbers_reproduced: Matches the builder. 28 bets, 16 games, 12.41 bets/day over 2.256 days. 22 bets have a close (15 games): CLV at the T-5 look price +3.72% [+2.82%, +4.64%] (builder [+2.81%, +4.59%]; bootstrap-seed difference only), 91% beat the close. Same bets at first c/w look +2.95% (builder +2.95%); paired gain +0.77 pts [+0.29, +1.43] over 15 games. ROI at the look price -17.4% on 26 settled/16 games [-59.8%, +22.6%]. Builder's halves reproduce only if split by START day (Oct 3: 6 bets +4.01%; Oct 4-5: 22 bets, 16 closes +3.61%); the shared date split (firstDay cut Oct 4) puts 25 bets in the first half and 3 in the second (2 closes, 2 games), so a half-vs-half check carries no information. Mix: 26 PROP, 1 SPREAD, 1 TEAM_TOTAL; 21 NFL, 6 NHL, 1 NCAAF; 15 of the 28 bets (8 games) are the single NFL 1 pm Oct 4 kickoff. Closes: 16 Tracker, 5 Novig-trades (9, 11, 19, 48, 9 trades), 1 Pinnacle, 6 none.
reason: Not a credible improvement, and not implementable as written. (1) As literally written (EV >= 2.5% only) 10 of 28 bets (36%) fail the auto-bet's own checks, so placing them would loosen limits: 3 were never in the app's CNO list at T-5 (found only by the study-only wide read, no book page), 4 have fewer than 3 books agreeing (the preset needs 3 agreeing, 2 pricing both sides), 1 is sharp-VETOED, 1 is a team total (kind not allowed), 1 has no book check by T-5. (2) Layered on the existing preset (no limit loosened) it is 18 bets = 8.0/day, and it adds almost nothing: 16 of those 18 already passed the preset EARLIER (median 9 min before the start, range 5 to 410), so the existing auto-bet would already own them; in 15 of 18 the price at the first pass is identical to the T-5 price. Paired CLV, T-5 price vs first-pass price, same bets, same close: +0.14 pts [-0.11, +0.51] over 13 games, 3 nonzero differences (+2.44, +0.97, -0.96 pts). Only 2 to 3 bets in 2.26 days are new. (3) As a REPLACEMENT for buying at first pass it would drop 88 of the 107 bets that pass the preset in the logged looks (82%; 47.4/day down to 8.4/day), whose first-pass CLV was +1.92% [+0.78%, +3.02%] on 83 closes/26 games. (4) The edge is circular: the Tracker close is the app's own CNO-books/Vigilant fair read 0 to 4 minutes after the buy (ClosingLine.kt: capture wakes 6 min before the start, final read ~110 s), so CLV is about EV: on the 16 Tracker closes mean EV at the look +3.73%, mean CLV +4.90% (CLV minus EV +1.17 pts, SD 1.42, corr 0.49). The 6 independent closes (5 Novig trades, 1 Pinnacle) average +0.58% against +3.38% EV; among the 18 preset-passing bets the 4 independent closes average +0.16%. (5) It would be worth cents: about $15 staked a day at 1/4 Kelly of $250; at +3.5% claimed EV that is $0.53/day, at the +0.16% to +0.58% independent-close level $0.02 to $0.09/day. (6) It is one of 522 variants tried, selected on 28 bets of which 54% sit in one kickoff cluster.
caveats: WHAT THE APP HAS: no setting expresses 'wait until N minutes before the start'. ScanSettings.trapEarlyHours (TrapGuard) is an upper bound in whole hours (1..999; chips 0/3/6/12/24): it lets a bet be bought at ANY time inside the window, it does not hold it. AutoBettor.MIN_LEAD_MS = 60_000 (AutoBettor.kt:711, gate at ~line 175) is a fixed lower bound. R8 needs new code: a minutes-based window in AutoBettor.run's pregame gate plus per-bet hold-back state, and the existing auto-bet's buy-at-first-pass must be suppressed or R8 is redundant. It is not a preset change (Presets.kt PresetRules has no timing field).

NO SAFETY LIMIT IS LOOSENED if R8 is layered on the preset: daily $500 (R8 needs about $15 to $23 a day), per game $70 (max R8 stake on one game $6.10), price tolerance 3 cents (PRICE_TOLERANCE), pregame-only (60 s lead; T-5 leaves 4 minutes), sharp veto, trap guard, halt on a lost order are all untouched. It DOES loosen the books/veto/kind/list checks if implemented as EV-only (10 of 28 bets, see reason). A late cycle (diagnostics: 9 late cycles, worst 7 min) would be blocked by the 60 s lead, so the rule would silently miss bets, not break a limit.

STAKES AT THE REAL CAPS (settings in force: 1/4 Kelly of $250 bankroll, auto-bet max $3.50 a bet, $500 a day, $70 a game): mean stake $1.85 (range $1.29 to $3.30); all 28 = $51.7 over 2.26 days = $22.9/day; the 18 preset-passing = $34.0 = $15.1/day; 4 of 28 have 'available' below the Kelly stake ($0.005 to $2.00). The caps never bind; volume and liquidity do.

INFORMATION AT DECISION TIME: no look-ahead found. The entry uses only looks at or before T = start - 5 min and the listed EV; no close is used to choose. But 4 of 28 bets (3 w-only + 1 dropped from the c list) are not visible to the app's list at T, 6 have no close at all (all 6 are among the 10 that fail the preset checks), and the books page the auto-bet needs is read for the top 10 candidates only (AutoScan.AUTO_BET_CHECK_TOP = 10), one page every 4 s (CnoFeed.AGREE_GAP_MS), kept 4 min (AGREE_TTL_MS). At the 1 pm NFL kickoff 19 candidates were listed at once: of the 18 preset-passing bets, 13 rank within the top 10 and 5 rank 12 to 18 (approximate: assumes CNO's order is by EV); 11 of 18 have a book check logged within 4 min of T (logging is on change, so this understates reads).

CLOSE AVAILABILITY: 26 of 28 are props. In the whole study 843 of 1320 props (64%) have no close; closes are 180 Tracker, 291 Novig-trades, 6 Pinnacle, 0 ESPN; independent (non-Tracker) usable closes exist for 217 props (16%). All 228 Tracker closes in the file are on bets Tj or the auto-bet placed (0 on unplaced bets). Of the 16 Tracker-closed R8 bets, 10 were placed by hand from the bet sheet and 5 to 6 by the auto-bet, 5 to 10 minutes before the start. A deployed R8 would produce its own circular Tracker closes (read minutes after the buy), so it could not validate itself.

WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT (a QUESTION FOR TJ, not an action): a shadow log, no money: for every bet that passes the preset record the price, EV and book check at T-5 and the later independent close (Pinnacle where it exists, Novig trades with at least 3 trades). With per-bet SD of CLV 6.2% on props with independent closes (n 217, 24 games, mean -0.18%), a +-1 pt CI needs about 146 independent-close bets (about 888 R8 bets, 105 days at 8.4/day) and +-0.5 pt about 584 (about 3,550 bets, 422 days), before game clustering widens it. Also worth asking: does Tj want a rule that makes the 15 of 18 same-price cases wait at all, given the price is identical?

APPROXIMATIONS in the first-pass test: it replays the logged c/k looks with the preset in force now (edge >= 2.5% at the CNO list price, 2+ two-sided, 3+ agree, odds -200 to +130, kinds PROP/MONEYLINE/SPREAD, edge <= 15%, sharp not VETOED, 1+ min to start) over the whole period although the preset changed between v0.57 and v0.70.1; it ignores the live Novig price, the check EV, the per-game cap (378 skips in the counters), the top-10 read limit and cooldowns, so it is an upper bound on what the app would have bought (the app placed 111 bets in 4 days, about 28/day; the replay gives 47/day). A 19th bet passes at T-5 in the preset-only replay that the builder's 28 do not contain.

SAMPLE: 2.26 days of first-looks, 16 games, 15 of 28 bets from one kickoff; the second date half has 3 bets. The result is descriptive only; nothing here is evidence of an edge, and nothing is evidence against a late-timing effect either, because the evaluation cannot see one.
